svg.title: No school record in the next two years
svg.desc: No school record in the next two years. Historical definition. Adjusted descriptive difference (pp): no school record in the next two years. Not school dropout. Nominal uncertainty intervals: annual 95%; pooled 98.75%. 2005: +1.6 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2006: +3.7 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2007: +2.0 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2008: +0.3 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2009: +1.2 pp; SCHOOL_CLUSTER_CI; 2010: +0.2 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2011: +4.8 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2012: +2.7 pp; SCHOOL_CLUSTER_CI; 2013: +1.2 pp; SCHOOL_CLUSTER_CI; 2014: +2.7 pp; SCHOOL_CLUSTER_CI; 2015: +2.5 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; pooled: +1.9 pp; SCHOOL_CLUSTER_CI. Period-specific scale; do not compare lengths across panels. † Weak precision or no valid interval.
